llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了钼和钢的选择性激光熔化过程模拟，未涉及生物医学植入物或骨整合相关性能。

summary_zh.motivation: 模拟钼和钢在SLM过程中的热流体动力学行为
summary_zh.method: 建立热流体动力学模型模拟逐层熔融堆积过程
summary_zh.result: 揭示了熔池动态和层间结合特性

summary_en.motivation: To simulate the thermo-fluid dynamics during selective laser melting of molybdenum and steel for understanding layer build-up.
summary_en.method: A thermo-fluid dynamical simulation was developed to model the melt pool behavior and layer deposition.
summary_en.result: The simulation captured key features of melt pool dynamics and interlayer bonding.
summary_en.validation: The study used a numerical simulation case without experimental validation.
